title: Target-addressed multi-target presentation planning from resolved facts
objective: Carry Step 5B multi-target resolved truth across the presentation boundary while preserving target identity and keeping presentation fully read-only.
hypothesis: A generic planner can emit one global Cast cue plus ordered target-addressed Impact/optional Defeat cues directly from immutable resolved facts, while preserving the skill visual profile and inventing no travel/timing/spatial semantics.
claim_boundary: No Unity VFX/playback is implemented or claimed. The planner does not select targets, spend MP, calculate damage, mutate HP/MP, infer ElementPosition geometry, or invent travel paths, timing, prefab, sound, camera or spatial sequencing.
design_constraints: Do not modify verified Step 5B combat-domain ABI.
Reuse existing SkillPresentationCue for cue semantics.
Keep one global SkillCast cue separate from target-addressed cues.
Preserve target order and target identity from MultiTargetSkillCastResolution<TKey>.
Mirror resolved Damage amount exactly and add TargetDefeated only when the resolved target is defeated.
Reject mismatched skill IDs and duplicate target keys.
Expose all collections through read-only wrappers, not raw arrays.
Preserve VisualArchetype and VisualProfileKey without pretending they imply an unverified playback sequence.
Do not emit Travel cues in this generic multi-target slice.

attempts.description: Add additive multi-target presentation plan types, generic planner, and eight regression tests; wire them into the existing .NET fast lane.
attempts.expected_tests: existing 90 tests plus 8 multi-target presentation tests = 98

next_recommended_experiment: If verified, Step 5 is mechanically complete at the pure-domain/presentation-contract level; proceed to Step 6 healing/support mechanics while leaving Unity playback as a separate heavy-lane adapter task.
